description: Send an end-to-end encrypted text message to an already-paired, active peer agent (by name or device id). The text leaves this machine: never include secrets, credentials or private code your user has not approved sharing. Returns the message id; state becomes "delivered" once the peer's bridge confirms receipt (check with wokitoki_list_messages).

replyTo.description: id of the message this answers

name: wokitoki_send_message
